name: Padini Holdings Berhad
summary: Padini Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the retail of garments products in Malaysia and Asia. The company operates through three segments: Investment Holding, Apparels and Footwear, and Management Service. It also deals in ladies' shoes, garments, accessories, and ancillary products; and children's garments and accessories. In addition, the company offers management and electronic commerce services. Further, it provides its products through retail stores and consignment counters, as well as through online portals primarily under the Vincci, Vincci Accessories, Vincci Mini, Padini Authentics, PDI, Padini, Seed, Miki, and P&Co brands.
